meta.name: render-glassy-matte-grwm
meta.description: Assemble a multi-scene GRWM beauty-demo ad from a config — a locked-identity creator applies ~5 products step by step while a SEPARATE ElevenLabs voiceover narrates and every scene cut is snapped to the VO's product-name word-starts (Whisper word-level timestamps), then ~5 Playwright product overlay cards (real PDP-verified taglines) are composited onto the master each on its product-NAME word-start, the SEPARATE VO is mixed on top of a ducked music bed at loudnorm I=-14, clean-white 3-words/cue captions are burned, and the video closes on a flat-lay end card. This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (re-cut to the VO word-starts, hard-concat, Playwright card render + card composite, VO plus music mix, caption burn, flat-lay end card); the VO, scene clips, product cutouts, and music come from create-music-elevenlabs / create-image-gpt-image-fal / create-video-fal. Use for the glassy-matte-grwm format.

copy.tagline: 根据配置自动合成多场景美妆广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化生成带配音和产品卡片的GRWM美妆广告视频。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically assemble multi-scene beauty ad videos from a config.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to auto-generate GRWM beauty ads with voiceover and product cards.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装一个多场景的“跟我一起化妆”广告视频：它会把一段独立的语音旁白、多个化妆步骤的视频片段、产品图片和背景音乐拼在一起，并在旁白提到产品名称的瞬间插入产品卡片和字幕，最后加上一个产品平铺的结尾画面。整个过程不花一分钱。
howto.when: 当你提供一段独立的语音旁白（含每个词的精确时间戳）、每个化妆步骤的视频片段、产品图片和背景音乐，并指定使用“glassy-matte-grwm”格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个DIBS Beauty的5步玻璃哑光教程广告。
say.note: Claude会要求你提供语音、视频片段等素材，然后自动组装。

say.text: 用我录好的旁白和素材，生成一个GRWM视频。
say.note: Claude会按照旁白的时间点剪辑画面并添加产品卡片。

say.text: 把这段语音和这些视频片段合成一个带字幕和音乐的美妆广告。
say.note: Claude会完成剪辑、混音、加字幕等所有步骤。
